subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts (service keys, MFA, access reviews)
messages:
From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@veridianhealth.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.example, laura.bennett@redwood.example
Cc: compliance@veridianhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request

Sergio / Laura,

Thanks for the time during our vendor QBR this week. As part of our procurement compliance we need the following from Redwood to complete our security review and sign-off for the upcoming pilot:

- SOC 2 Type II report covering period ending 2026-12-31 (PDF).
- A bridge letter that explicitly states how the controls in the report map to the period 2027-01-01 through 2027-03-31 (or confirmation of audit coverage).
- Supplemental artifacts for items where your report delegates or references operational controls:
  - A one-week slice of service-account key rotation records (showing rotation timestamps, who/what rotated, and associated key IDs).
  - MFA enforcement logs for interactive admin console logins during March 2027 (redacted where necessary).
  - Evidence of most recent formal access review (export or report).

If any of these require a separate NDA or secure transfer, let me know. Can you confirm a delivery timeline? Ideally we need this by next Friday (2027-04-23) to stay on schedule.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Morton
Senior IT Risk Manager | Veridian Health
alex.morton@veridianhealth.com

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.example
To: Alex Morton <alex.morton@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.example, olga.petrov@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Internal owners: Laura, Olga, Karthik (cc'd) — can you assemble the artifacts and confirm the redaction approach for any PII?

My initial notes:
- SOC 2 Type II (2026) PDF should be available. I'll arrange the signed bridge letter.
- Service-account key rotation: we can pull a CSV slice from our key management audit (rotation events). We’ll redact any actual key material and include key IDs and rotation timestamps and actor.
- MFA logs: we can extract enforcement events from the auth service for the March window. We should confirm the exact timezone and which admin accounts Veridian wants included (console-only vs API/admin service accounts).
- Access review: we can export the latest quarterly review artifacts (reviewer sign-off and suspects list) but may need to sanitize usernames per policy.

Can you confirm: (1) whether Veridian needs global admin scope only or all privileged accounts; (2) whether a hashed checksum of the raw CSV is acceptable instead of raw hash (we prefer to avoid sending production raw files over email).

I’ll push a tracking folder to your Drive and add the artifacts as they’re ready. Targeting early next week for most slices; bridge letter will be by EOD 2027-04-16.

—Sergio
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: olga.petrov@redwood.example
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.example, laura.bennett@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example, Alex Morton <alex.morton@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request

Alex / team — pulling the artifacts now. Quick status and approach:

- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf: will upload to the shared Drive link and mark with restricted viewer access.
- bridge_letter_20270415_signed.pdf: I’ll have Legal produce the one-page bridge with signature; will confirm auditor name for statement.
- svckey_rotation_slice_202703.csv: generated a 30-day slice for March 2027 showing rotation events for service accounts that have cross-account roles. Columns: key_id, rotated_by, rotation_timestamp_utc, previous_key_id, rotation_reason. We remove any base64 blobs or private material.
- mfa_enforcement_log_slice_202703.json: pulled enforcement events for interactive admin console logins between 2027-03-01 and 2027-03-31 UTC. Fields redacted: ip_address partially, username normalized to redacted identifiers.
- access_review_export_202703.xlsx: exported reviewer decisions for the April 2027 quarterly review (covers March activity). PII cells replaced with internal IDs per policy.

Notes/asks:
- Alex, please confirm you want (A) "Global admin + Role-admin" only or (B) "All users with write privileges to production resources". Option A is narrower and quicker.
- We will provide SHA256 checksums for the raw CSV/JSON files in a separate secure message (not in email body). Is that acceptable?

I’ll upload the files to the Drive folder and post links once ready. Expected upload: tomorrow morning 2027-04-16.

Olga Petrov
Sr. InfoSec Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@veridianhealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.example, sergio.alvarez@redwood.example
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example, compliance@veridianhealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request

Thanks, Olga. Option A (Global admin + Role-admin) is sufficient for our review. A few quick clarifications:

- For the svckey_rotation_slice, can you include the key owner team and whether the rotation was automated vs manual?
- For MFA logs, we need evidence that MFA enforcement was configured (policy identifiers) and examples of enforcement events (not more than 7 days of raw events). The redactions are fine.
- For the access review export, a summary page that shows reviewer, decision, and scope is helpful — we understand the PII replacements.

Regarding checksums: SHA256 for the raw files is fine; please send the checksum by a different channel (we can accept a secure Drive comment or HubSpot secure doc).

Also, please confirm who signed the SOC 2 PDF (auditor firm and signing partner). That helps our audit trail.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
